title: Lifecycle Rule
description: Seasonal availability windows, active -> discontinued transitions, substitute-item rules for when an item goes out of stock/end-of-life.

item_id.description: References an id in this category's structure/items.yaml.

season_window.description: Required when status is 'seasonal' - the recurring date range (month-day) this item is available.

substitute_item_id.description: References another id in this category's structure/items.yaml - offered when this item is unavailable (out of season or discontinued).
